nodes.title: Start here · A model chooses an artwork palette
widgets_values:
DEMO: Use a bounded Qwen decision as a creative control. Local Decision selects blue or orange; Choice to Value maps that label to a numeric hue; Genereti Livecode applies it to a moving circle. The model never writes executable code.

Requires Genereti public + GeneretiCore.
1. The saved artwork starts on open; use editor Run after code edits.
2. Download Qwen 0.6B on local decision if missing.
3. Press TOP Run: the model chooses blue/orange; the map turns that label into a hue, which drives p5.
4. Change the scene prompt and Run again.
The small model can choose poorly. The graph maps allowed labels to numbers; it never executes model-written code.
Scroll down and Run the walkthrough for guided steps.
